text:
oz: Quick note from tonight's DR run. One tenant experienced asymmetric behavior: reads served from eu-west but writes were being rejected. Ops couldn't tell if proxies were stale or controller forced a move.

hana: do we have the relevant headers/log lines?

oz: proxy header sample:
GET /api/v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.internal
X-Region-Lease: eu-west-1;owner=proxy-12;lease-ts=1710001111
X-Trace: c3f2...

controller kv write (excerpt):
/leases/acct-843 -> region=eu-central-1;owner=controller-2;ev=ev-71b

pete: classic visibility gap: proxies and controller speak different ids and there is no canonical event to join. Operators just saw errors.

sara: proposal: introduce a single lease event model and minimal wire changes so we can correlate end-to-end.

proposal summary:
- Controller: on any lease decision write a lease event object with fields (event_id, tenant, desired_region, reason) and write it to kv atomically with the lease update. If KV write fails, still emit a timeline event with reason=kv-fail.
- Proxy: accept optional header X-Lease-Event-Id on responses/requests and emit it from their logs when the controller-provided event_id is present. If proxy receives no event_id, it continues to function but logs that it is operating on a stale/unknown lease.
- Operator UI: ingest lease events into timeline and join with proxy acks using event_id. Display region-health {ok,degraded,stale} and reason.
- Metrics/alerts: lease_event_published_total, lease_event_ack_latency_seconds, lease_event_missing_ack_count. Alert if missing_ack_count > 0 for 2m or if lease_event_ack_latency > 15s for production tenants.

hana: addendum: header names should be kebab-case: X-Lease-Event-Id, X-Consent-Decision, X-Consent-Source. Limit event_id to 36 char UUID.

pete: also add consent semantics: for tenants tagged residency=restricted, controller must be fail-closed on consent query timeouts. If consent svc times out, controller emits event reason=consent-unavailable and blocks auto-swap. Human override via UI allowed with audit.

sara: runbook sketch: on residency-mismatch + lease_event with reason consent-unavailable -> check consent svc health, don't force-swap. If ops approves, use UI action to attach operator id and issue force-swap event which must include explicit justification.

ops-bot: [note] owners assigned: oz(controller), hana(proxy), pete(ui), sara(runbooks). RFC due EOD tomorrow.

hana: implementation estimate: proxy header shims ~ a day; controller event write + timeline emit ~2 days; ui join + alerting ~3 days; canary on 5 tenants then roll.

pete: QA: ensure active-active (multi-write) tenants bypass fail-closed rule; controller checks tenant.flags.multi_write.

sara: tiny UX ask: timeline should link event -> controller trace id and proxy traces for one-click jump. That cuts triage time.

oz: agreed. I'll draft RFC with event schema, header spec, prometheus metric names, and runbook snippets. Link here when ready.

pete: :thumbsup:

hana: small compatibility note: proxies can start emitting received event_id in logs even before controller writes become widespread; UI join tolerant if event_id missing.

oz: thanks all. follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 PT.
